title: Syeda Day Naal Fizza Nay Enjh Di Wafa Nibhayi
body:
Zahra Di Nokri Laye (x2) Chadtah Jo Taqt Aayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Patharaan Diyaan Barsaata, Zainab Day Naal Jhaliyaan
Safraan Ch Maar Di Raye Ay, Sajjad Di Diyaan Taliyaan
Baaqi Di Zindagi Fizza, Vich Shaam Day Bittayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Nay Turna Sikhiya, Fizza Da Hath Pakaar Kay
Pharay Shaam Sain Khutbay, Aydi Kandt Day Olay Khar Kay
Maana Farraz Nibhaya, Syeda Di Ho Kay Daayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kitta Fizza Jad Elaan Ay, Habshah Di Main Shahzadi
Ay Jo Nangay Saar Khari Ay, Zainab Batool Zaadi
Aye Sun Kay Habshiyaan Nay, Talvaar Cha Uthayi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lokon Fizza Nay Duniya Tay, Enjh Da Maqam Paya
Char Waqt Day Imaman Nu, Hathi Ene Khadaya
Baqir Ne Laash Ess Di, Khud Qabr Vich Lahaayi.
